properties.name: capture-intent asks what could be taken away before a structural addition (via negativa, advisory), for every design
properties.rationale: Anthony kept via negativa as an advisory question, barbell-style (rule:before-a-structural-addition-ask-what-could-be-taken-away). Measured the same night, that rule reached an agent only through the capture-intent skill on reflow2's own design. Its tool-description delivery was frozen by flo2's gateway memo (flo2's fact:root-cause-the-gateway-remembers-each-designs-tool-list-once-so-lessons-written-later-never-reach-tools-list-2026-10-12), and other designs never see reflow2's lessons. His word: "Add the question to reflow2's built-in capture-intent skill, so it reaches every design. That's a small reflow2 PR and then a release." The skill is served from the binary, so every design gets the question at the next release. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
